For palette transformations, infer the complete mapping of every present color—including background, marker, and output colors—from the demos; do not assume foreground identity or reuse a mapping from a previous task. Test the candidate mapping on every cell of every demo before accepting it. If multiple demos show a rectangular frame with missing edge cells recolored, test the foreground bounding box's perimeter as the candidate rule: recolor only background cells on its min/max row or column, never the interior, and accept it only if it exactly reproduces every demo.

Revisit every demo, and run the current transform on each exact demo input; compare the program-produced grids cell-for-cell with the expected outputs before using its test output again. A plausible rule is not validated until these checks pass. Then revise the rule to account for mismatches, requesting a discriminating demo when evidence remains ambiguous. After every edit, rerun all demo regressions. If the demos do not establish the rule (including when the cap is exhausted), keep uncertainty explicit and don't call a heuristic verified. Save a validated replacement only when the instance ends as directed, and confirm the write.

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Grid is divided by 8-lines into cells; a 2 seed fills its entire cell.
    # 3 seeds at matching columns in a row-band encode a horizontal stripe of 3s,
    # and fill the cell between them with 6s.
    rdiv = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 8 for v in grid[r])]
    cdiv = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + rdiv + [h]
    cb = [-1] + cdiv + [w]
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        r0, r1 = rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            c0, c1 = cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1]
            seeds = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] in (2,3)]
            if not seeds: continue
            if any(v == 2 for _,_,v in seeds):
                for r in range(r0,r1):
                    for c in range(c0,c1): out[r][c]=2
            elif any(v == 3 for _,_,v in seeds):
                # Row-band with 3 markers at corresponding vertical position: mark all other cells 3;
                # central cell becomes 6.
                rr = seeds[0][0]
                matching = [j for j in range(len(cb)-1) if any(grid[rr][c] == 3 for c in range(cb[j]+1,cb[j+1]))]
                if len(matching) >= 2:
                    for j in range(len(cb)-1):
                        a,b=cb[j]+1,cb[j+1]
                        for r in range(r0,r1):
                            for c in range(a,b): out[r][c]=6 if j not in matching else 3
    return out
